name: manifest-dev
description: Manifest-driven development: /figure-out reaches shared understanding, /define writes Deliverables with Acceptance Criteria and Global Invariants, and /do implements them. Verify blocks carry topology-neutral instructions plus optional phase; execution policy is selected at /do launch as consolidated (independent default), per-gate, or self, with an optional verifier model for independent modes. Every mode keeps a provenance-rich gate ledger and the run never downgrades itself. A default-on execution log preserves deviations and dead-end memory; --no-log opts out. For unattended runs, use a host-native goal-setting backstop whose completion contract requires fresh PASS evidence for every gate under the selected mode. /auto chains the full flow, and /figure-out-team extends deliberation to multi-party Slack sessions.
